map.提示：Hadlock四参数法误差约±10-15%，是临床最常用估算方法。宫高腹围: Tip: the Hadlock 4-parameter method has ~+/-10-15% error and is the most used clinically. Fundal-height/girth is greatly affected by maternal build and amniotic fluid. Fetal-weight estimation is auxiliary, not diagnostic.

map.出生体重 ≥4000g 为巨大儿（部分国家 ≥4500g），与母体糖尿病、过期妊: Birth weight >=4000 g (some countries >=4500 g); linked to maternal diabetes and post-term, raising dystocia and birth-trauma risk.
